A Zariski-locally trivial bundle with irreducible fibre P² over an irreducible base component is irreducible, so components of I are exactly the inverse images of components of S.
checked_claims.statement: Over reduced S, the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence is a P²-bundle I≅P_S((π_*L)^∨), and its irreducible components correspond to those of S.

checked_claims.note: A base point p would make L(-p) a g²₅. The hyperelliptic branch of the genus-six g²₅ classification is already excluded because every degree-four pencil on a hyperelliptic curve is hyperelliptic-composed (hence barred by (BAL)+FND-0125), so the plane-quintic exclusion FND-0130 applies and contradicts balance. Given base-point-freeness, |L_s| defines a morphism to P²; in characteristic zero a general hyperplane avoids the finitely many branch values and singularities of the (possibly non-birational) image, so the pullback is six distinct points even when the morphism has degree >1 onto its image. Hence V_s is a nonempty dense open of |L_s|≅P². The argument correctly does not rely on χ(L)=1.
checked_claims.statement: L is fibrewise base-point-free, and the distinct-support open V is nonempty and dense in every P² fibre.

checked_claims.note: Scheme-theoretic equality of ideals on Conf₆ is the twice-confirmed ATT-0065/ATT-0066 input (Fitting/Picard identity plus ordered distinct-support comparison), used within recorded scope. The universal divisor over V is finite étale of degree six by construction of the distinct-support open, so its frame scheme is an S₆-torsor under the constant group. Freeness of the deck action is immediate: a permutation fixing an ordered tuple of six pairwise-distinct points is the identity. The claim is a torsor claim (valid at stack level) and makes no coarse-moduli quotient assertion.
checked_claims.statement: On Conf₆, Z_ev is scheme-theoretically the ordered incidence over V, and Z_ev→V is a finite étale S₆-torsor with free deck action.

checked_claims.note: V is S-smooth of relative dimension two as an open of a P²-bundle; finite étale base change preserves smoothness, so Z_ev is S-smooth of relative dimension two. Conf₆(C/S) is S-smooth of relative dimension six (open of C⁶_S with diagonals removed). A closed immersion between S-smooth schemes is a regular immersion, and pure relative dimensions give constant codimension 6−2=4 with locally free conormal of rank four. No determinantal expected-codimension argument is invoked.
checked_claims.statement: Z_ev→S is smooth of pure relative dimension two, and Z_ev↪Conf₆(C/S) is a regular immersion of pure codimension four with locally free rank-four conormal.

checked_claims.note: Finite flat maps satisfy going-down, so the generic point of a component of Z_ev maps to a generic point of V; the finite image is closed and contains that generic point, hence equals the component V_α. Finite maps preserve dimension, giving dim(S_α)+2. The explicit refusal to count components of Z_ev is honest scoping, not a gap in the stated theorem.
checked_claims.statement: Every irreducible component of Z_ev maps finitely and surjectively onto an irreducible component V_α and has dimension dim(S_α)+2 whenever S_α is finite-dimensional.

Consequently a family satisfying the ATT-0094 hypotheses (fibrewise balanced F_s ≅ O(4)⊕O(5) together with FND-0125) has no hyperelliptic geometric fibres.

theorem_statement: Let k be a characteristic-zero field and S a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme. Let π:C→S be a smooth proper family of geometrically connected genus-six curves equipped with a finite flat degree-four map γ:C→P¹_S, the standard degree-four Casnati–Ekedahl resolution, fibrewise balanced relations bundle F_s≅O(4)⊕O(5), its canonical filtration with quotient W_5 of degree 16, and the weak relative-canonical normalization (N). Put L=W_5⊗ω_{C/S}^{-1}, let I=Hilb⁶(C/S)×_{Pic⁶(C/S)}S be the Abel–Jacobi incidence over [L], let V=I^{dist} be its distinct-support open, and let Z_ev⊂Conf₆(C/S) be the intrinsic evaluation-failure scheme. Then every geometric fibre has h⁰(L_s)=3 and h¹(L_s)=2; I≅P_S((π_*L)^∨) is a P²-bundle; V is nonempty and dense in every fibre; and Z_ev is scheme-theoretically the ordered incidence over V. The morphism Z_ev→V is a finite étale S₆-torsor with free deck action, Z_ev→S is smooth of pure relative dimension two, and Z_ev↪Conf₆(C/S) is a regular immersion of pure codimension four with locally free conormal of rank four. Irreducible components of I and V correspond to irreducible components of S; every irreducible component of Z_ev maps finitely and surjectively onto one component of V and, over a finite-dimensional component S_α, has dimension dim(S_α)+2. No count of the components of Z_ev is asserted.
